description: For an AI agent about to pay, or to submit card or account details, on a website: returns one action — 'do_not_pay', 'stop_and_ask_user' or 'no_fraud_found' — with the reason and the report link. 'do_not_pay' means the domain is published as fraudulent with evidence, or hides instructions aimed at AI agents. Anything not settled, including a domain never assessed, is 'stop_and_ask_user': hand the decision back to the person, never proceed on your own. 'no_fraud_found' is not a guarantee. Call it with the merchant's domain, not a payment page URL. desenmascara.me assesses whether a website domain is fraudulent, using evidence gathered at a point in time. It can and does decline to judge when the evidence is insufficient. It assesses domains, not URLs, and its assessment does not establish that a particular payment or action is safe.
